pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block
pages.text: A coil of cosmic neutronium over spacetime alloy, cooled cryogenically and threaded with pentaquark shards. It runs hotter than anything below it and seems to pull faintly on the room. The windings are so dense that they barely look like separate turns.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transcendent Plasma Forge demanded hotter coils still. I wound cosmic neutronium over a spacetime alloy coil, with a hyperdimensional processor to handle the load and pentaquark shards to stabilise it.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Component Tiers.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Transcendent Plasma Forge, Transfinite Coil Block.
